verses.html: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.text: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

verses.html: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.text: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

verses.html: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.text: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

verses.html: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

verses.html: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.text: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

verses.html: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.text: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

verses.html: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
verses.text: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

verses.html: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

verses.html: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.text: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

verses.html: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.text: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

verses.html: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

verses.html: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.text: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

verses.html: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.text: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

verses.html: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
verses.text: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

verses.html: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verses.text: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
